data.narrative:
StoreDot is a Series E climate and energy technology company founded by Doron Myersdorf, Simon Litsyn, and Gil Rosenman. The company has raised $206.5M to date. The Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 peer companies across public and private markets—1 public comparable (LNZA) and 8 private peers including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—though narrow peer filtering at identical stage and valuation tier yielded insufficient datapoints for reliable median-based analysis.

The valuation assessment relies on stage-progression methodology, which applies a 1.4x step-up multiplier typical of Series E advancement to the $206M total capital raised proxy. This approach yields an implied valuation of $289M. The peer-median method was not applicable; while 9 same-sector companies exist, none of the adjacent-stage or similar-tier subsets contained the minimum three datapoints required to establish a credible median benchmark without undue sector-wide extrapolation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $246M to $332M, centered on $289M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression point estimate. Key uncertainties include the absence of tight peer comparables at Series E stage within the Climate & Energy sector, which limits cross-validation. Any revised valuation should incorporate updated funding rounds, exit multiples, or peer financials as they become available.
